primary_fallback: original/flip coordinate vote at score >= 0.055 per class
secondary_fixed: detector-specific frozen selection supplied with weights
matching: Within class, IoU >= 0.50, one-to-one greedy. Prioritize pairs with both frozen votes, then one, then neither. Ties resolved by IoU then score product.
coordinates: mean of the two detector boxes
pair_score: geometric mean of the incoming scores. Scores are ordering signals, not calibrated probabilities.
set_supplement: Use frozen training OOF P94 settings (0.64/0.63). Only unmatched same-class boxes with no >=0.5 overlap insert, behind corroborated boxes in order.
primary_extra_candidates: Append vote boxes with no >=0.5 overlap to the same class of any original primary frozen output. Preserve actual frozen crop expert proposals.
deployment: Two defect backbones total; original sources support crop and set models. Stage segmentation not counted as a defect backbone; full latency must include it.
speed: CPU cache replay for accuracy only
data: No fitting, calibration or parameter search on dev. This comparison follows the earlier single-model experiments on the same dev split.
